name: create_domain
description: Designs and creates a new user domain. LLM proposes a schema. User reviews, optionally adds tables, and confirms. DDL is executed, CRUD workflows are generated, entity schemas are registered, and the domain is immediately usable from /mind.

steps.description: LLM designs full domain schema. Must produce one primary table (no FK references) and zero or more child tables referencing it.
Enrich each table with columnSummary and domain field.
steps.expression: (function() { var SYS = new Set(['id','created_at','updated_at']); function enrich(tables, domain) {  return tables.map(function(t) {   if (!t.columns) return t;   var cols = t.columns.filter(function(c){ return !SYS.has(c.name); }).slice(0,4).map(function(c){ return c.name; });   return Object.assign({}, t, { columnSummary: cols.join(', '), domain: domain });  }); } return enrich(items, local_state.proposed_scaffold.domain); })()

steps.description: User reviews proposed table list. Child tables may be removed. User may also add a table.
steps.message_template: Here's my plan for domain {{proposed_scaffold.domain}}. You can remove child tables you don't need, or add one that's missing.

modal.title: Add a table
modal.placeholder: What it stores and how it relates to the other tables.

steps.description: User describes the table they want to add.
steps.message_template: Describe the table you want to add — what it stores and how it relates to the other tables.

steps.description: LLM designs the new table from user description.
Merge new_table from local_state into proposed_scaffold.tables, re-enrich. Loops back to step 3.
steps.expression: (function() { var SYS = new Set(['id','created_at','updated_at']); function enrich(tables, domain) {  return tables.map(function(t) {   if (!t.columns) return t;   var cols = t.columns.filter(function(c){ return !SYS.has(c.name); }).slice(0,4).map(function(c){ return c.name; });   return Object.assign({}, t, { columnSummary: cols.join(', '), domain: domain });  }); } var merged = local_state.new_table ? items.concat([local_state.new_table]) : items; return enrich(merged, local_state.proposed_scaffold.domain); })()

steps.description: User reviews the full column details of all tables before DDL is executed.
steps.message_template: Here are the full details for all tables in domain {{proposed_scaffold.domain}}. Review the columns before we create them.

steps.description: Final confirmation before DDL execution.
steps.message_template: Ready to create domain {{proposed_scaffold.domain}} with {{proposed_scaffold.tables.length}} tables. This will create the physical database tables.

steps.description: Create each confirmed PGD table via SERV-Schema createTable. Each table object carries domain field so PGC_Schema rows have domain populated.

Derive domain registration data deterministically from confirmed scaffold — no LLM. Produces domainHelp, intentMapRows, and entitySchemas. Entity name uses the same toEntityName convention as classify-intent.mjs (TitleCase singular). This is the single authoritative source for entity naming — never an LLM.
steps.expression: (() => { const domain = items.domain; const tables = items.tables; function toEntityName(d) { const words = d.split('_'); const titled = words.map(w => w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1)); const last = titled[titled.length - 1]; if (last.endsWith('s') && last.length > 2) titled[titled.length - 1] = last.slice(0, -1); return titled.join(''); } const entityName = toEntityName(domain); const words = domain.split('_'); const aliases = Array.from(new Set([domain, domain.replace(/_/g, ' '), entityName.toLowerCase(), words[words.length - 1]])); const domainHelp = { domain, aliases, description: 'Manage your ' + domain.replace(/_/g, ' ') + ' data', commands: [ { syntax: '/m list ' + domain, description: 'List all records' }, { syntax: '/m get ' + domain + ' <name or id>', description: 'Find a specific record' }, { syntax: '/m add ' + domain + ' <description>', description: 'Add a new record' }, { syntax: '/m update ' + domain + ' id=<n> <field>=<value>', description: 'Update a record' }, { syntax: '/m delete ' + domain + ' id=<n>', description: 'Delete a record' } ] }; const intentMapRows = [ { pattern: 'add.' + domain + '|add ' + domain + '|add my ' + domain, intent_category: 'add_entity', action_type: 'workflow' }, { pattern: 'list.' + domain + '|list ' + domain + '|list my ' + domain, intent_category: 'list_entity', action_type: 'workflow' }, { pattern: 'get.' + domain + '|get ' + domain + '|find ' + domain, intent_category: 'get_entity', action_type: 'workflow' }, { pattern: 'update.' + domain + '|update ' + domain + '|edit ' + domain, intent_category: 'update_entity', action_type: 'workflow' }, { pattern: 'delete.' + domain + '|delete ' + domain + '|remove ' + domain, intent_category: 'delete_entity', action_type: 'workflow' } ]; const rootTable = tables.find(function(t) { return !t.foreignKeys || t.foreignKeys.length === 0; }) || tables[0]; const childTables = tables.filter(function(t) { return t.tableName !== rootTable.tableName; }); const joins = childTables.map(function(t) { const alias = t.tableName.replace('PGD_', '').toLowerCase(); const fk = t.foreignKeys && t.foreignKeys[0]; return { type: 'LEFT', table: t.tableName, alias: alias, on: fk ? alias + '.' + fk.column + ' = r.id' : null }; }); const aggregations = childTables.map(function(t) { const alias = t.tableName.replace('PGD_', '').toLowerCase(); const cols = (t.columns || []).filter(function(c) { return c.name !== 'id' && c.name !== 'created_at' && c.name !== 'updated_at'; }).map(function(c) { return c.name; }); return { alias: alias, columns: cols, outputKey: alias }; }); const entitySchemas = [{ entity_name: entityName, description: entityName + ' entity for the ' + domain + ' domain', root_table: rootTable.tableName, domain: domain, joins: joins, aggregations: aggregations, filters: [], upsert_key: [] }]; return { domainHelp: domainHelp, intentMapRows: intentMapRows, entitySchemas: entitySchemas }; })()

steps.description: User reviews and confirms aliases and CRUD commands before they are written to PGC_DomainHelp.
steps.message_template: Almost done. Here are the aliases and commands I'll register for your domain. Confirm to proceed.

steps.description: Write confirmed domain aliases and commands to PGC_DomainHelp.
Insert the 5 PGC_IntentMap rows produced by step 6. intent_category values are *_entity (generic) — derived deterministically from domain name.
Register each generated entity schema in PGC_EntitySchema so SERV-Entity can serve multi-table queries for this domain.
Confirm domain creation with concrete command examples.

Try:

name: help
description: Interactive help — shows system commands or live domain help. Queries PGC_DomainHelp at runtime so the list grows as domains are added.

steps.description: Load all registered domain help entries so domain buttons are live data.
Build per-domain button list and domain lookup map from registered_domains.
steps.expression: (function() { var domainButtons = items.map(function(d) {  var label = d.domain + (d.description ? ' — ' + d.description : '');  return { action: d.domain, label: label.length > 75 ? label.slice(0,72) + '…' : label }; }); var domainMap = {}; items.forEach(function(d) { domainMap[d.domain] = d; }); return { domainButtons: domainButtons, domainMap: domainMap };})()

steps.description: Level 1 — What would you like help with? System commands or a specific domain.
steps.message_template: What would you like help with?

steps.description: Resolve selected help topic into formatted mrkdwn content.
steps.expression: (function() { var selection = local_state.help_selection; var domainMap = (local_state.help_options || {}).domainMap || {}; var domain = selection ? domainMap[selection] : null; var content; if (!domain) {  content = selection ? 'No help found for "' + selection + '".' : 'No topic selected.'; } else {  var lines = ['*' + (domain.description || domain.domain) + '*', '', '*Commands:*']   .concat((domain.commands || []).map(function(c) { return '• `' + c.syntax + '` — ' + c.description; }));  content = lines.join('\n'); } return { selection: selection, content: content };})()

steps.description: Level 2 — Display the resolved help content as the gate message. User can go back to the topic selector or dismiss.

name: create_workflow
description: Designs and stores a new reusable workflow in PGC_Workflow from a natural language description. Classifies intent, generates steps, simulates, and registers the workflow so it is immediately available to the Intent Preprocessor.

steps.description: Classify the workflow intent — extract domain, operation_type, target_tables, and a one-sentence description.
Generate the workflow step array. Injects live PGC_StepType contracts and the create_domain worked example from PGC_SystemContext at prompt build time.
User reviews the proposed step array before simulation. Can request changes (routes back to step 2) or cancel.
steps.message_template: Review the proposed steps for {{draft_workflow.name}}. Approve to simulate, or request changes to regenerate.

steps.description: Level 1 static analysis only — no mocks needed. Validates routing values, dead targets, missing templates, and gate structure.
Generate representative mock outputs for each step that produces data. Used as simulation inputs in Level 2 path execution.
Generate named simulation paths — happy path, cancel paths per gate, failure paths per llm_call and serv_* step.
Level 2 + Level 3 — full path execution using mock outputs and decision scripts. Validates data flow, template resolution, and terminal states.
Show simulation results and ask user to confirm registration.
steps.message_template: Simulation passed {{simulation_result.paths_passed}} of {{simulation_result.paths_run}} paths. Ready to register {{draft_workflow.name}}?

steps.description: Write the new workflow to PGC_Workflow.
Write the PGC_IntentMap row so the new workflow is immediately matchable by the Intent Preprocessor Pass 1a regex.
Confirm the workflow is registered and ready.
steps.message_template:
Workflow {{draft_workflow.name}} is registered and ready.

Try: /mind {{draft_workflow.description}}

name: get_entity
description: Find and display a domain entity record by id or name search including all child data. Generic — works for any domain. Requires input.entity_name and either input.id (exact lookup) or input.search (LIKE filter).

steps.description: Route to id lookup when input.id is set, otherwise fall through to name search.
Fetch entity by exact id.
Search for the entity by name using a LIKE filter on the primary display column.
Format matched entity with root columns and child arrays into Slack mrkdwn.
steps.expression:
(function() { var SYS = new Set(['id','created_at','updated_at']); var rows = Array.isArray(items) ? items : (items && typeof items === 'object' ? [items] : []); var maxRows = 5; var capped = rows.slice(0, maxRows); if (capped.length === 0) return 'No records found.'; var firstRow = capped[0] || {}; var allKeys = Object.keys(firstRow); var childKeys = allKeys.filter(function(k) { return Array.isArray(firstRow[k]); }); var scalarKeys = allKeys.filter(function(k) { return !Array.isArray(firstRow[k]) && !SYS.has(k); }); var lines = capped.map(function(row) {  var idPart = 'id=' + (row.id != null ? row.id : '—');  var rootParts = scalarKeys.map(function(col) { var val = row[col]; return col + '=' + (val == null ? '—' : String(val)); });  var rootLine = '• ' + [idPart].concat(rootParts).join(' | ');  if (false) return rootLine;  var childLines = childKeys.reduce(function(acc, key) {   var children = row[key];   if (!Array.isArray(children) || children.length === 0) return acc;   acc.push('  _' + key + ':_');   children.forEach(function(child) {    if (!child || typeof child !== 'object') { acc.push('    ◦ ' + child); return; }    var parts = Object.entries(child).filter(function(e) { return !SYS.has(e[0]) && !Array.isArray(e[1]); }).map(function(e) { return e[0] + '=' + (e[1] != null ? e[1] : '—'); });    acc.push('    ◦ ' + parts.join(' | '));   });   return acc;  }, []);  return [rootLine].concat(childLines).join('
'); }); var truncated = rows.length > maxRows ? '
_... and ' + (rows.length - maxRows) + ' more record(s) not shown._' : ''; return 'Found ' + rows.length + ' record(s).
' + lines.join('
') + truncated;})()

description: List all records for a domain entity with root columns and ids. Generic — works for any domain. Requires input.entity_name.

steps.description: List all entities ordered by name. Returns root and child columns — child arrays suppressed by root_only in step 2.
Format list results — root columns only, child arrays suppressed.

name: add_entity
description: Add a new domain entity record from natural language input. LLM parses description into structured data. User confirms before DB write. Generic — works for any domain. Requires input.entity_name.

steps.description: Load full entity schema: reads PGC_EntitySchema for join topology and PGC_Schema for live column definitions across root and all child tables.
Parse the user natural language description into a structured entity object using the full schema.
User reviews the parsed entity before any DB write.
steps.message_template: Here's what I parsed from your description. Does this look right?

steps.description: Insert the root entity row. System columns and child arrays excluded automatically.
Build flat array of child row inserts from parsed entity, injecting FK. Reads full_entity_schema, parsed_entity, new_record from local_state.
steps.expression: (function() { var entitySchema = items; var parsedEntity = local_state.parsed_entity; var newRecord = local_state.new_record; if (!entitySchema || !parsedEntity || !newRecord) return []; var rootId = newRecord.id; var children = Array.isArray(entitySchema.children) ? entitySchema.children : []; var inserts = []; children.forEach(function(child) {  var table = child.table, fk = child.fk_column, outKey = child.output_key;  if (!table || !fk || !outKey) return;  var childRows = parsedEntity.children && parsedEntity.children[outKey];  if (!Array.isArray(childRows) || childRows.length === 0) return;  childRows.forEach(function(row) {   var r = Object.assign({}, row); r[fk] = rootId;   inserts.push({ tableName: table, row: r });  }); }); return inserts;})()

steps.description: Insert each child row into its table with FK injected.
